completeness.why: Every action takes the income and hidden decision from shouldFillCategory with an explicit hidden mode ('flagged' for copyPreviousMonth, 'keep' for setZero, 'visible' via getAverageFillCategories for the averages), the averages' SQL no longer filters hidden itself, and both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount; setZero and copyPreviousMonth only keep their own data sources.

interface.why: The hidden mode names the preserved inconsistencies explicitly (setZero writes hidden, copy keeps missing-group categories, averages skip them) with no speculative options, though one enum bundles the hidden rule and the missing-group rule together.

disguised_duplication.where: The three copies of the category SQL and the per-action income/sign checks are removed and replaced by calls to shared functions.
